bead.title: opencode: replace fictional-format runner tests with real-JSONL fixtures
bead.description:
PROBLEM: internal/harnesses/opencode/runner_test.go:235-291 (TestRunner_Execute_FinalUsageTotals) and runner_test.go:371-402 (TestParseOpencodeStream_WithUsage) assert against {"usage":{"input_tokens":15,...},"total_cost_usd":0.003} — a format opencode NEVER emits. These green-on-fiction tests actively block the parser/usage fixes and give false confidence. TestRunner_Execute_HappyPath (runner_test.go:160) feeds plain text, also not the real JSONL.

ROOT CAUSE: tests authored against an assumed envelope, never validated against the real opencode CLI.

PROPOSED FIX: Delete/rewrite TestRunner_Execute_FinalUsageTotals, TestParseOpencodeStream_WithUsage, and TestRunner_Execute_HappyPath to drive the real JSONL fixtures (testdata/jsonl/text_only.jsonl, tool_use.jsonl) through a fake `opencode` shell binary that cats the fixture (the existing fake-binary test harness in runner_test.go). Keep TestRunner_Execute_AppliesRequestControls (arg wiring) and TestRunner_Execute_RequestTimeout / ExitErrorIncludesStderr (process control, format-independent).

NON-SCOPE: do not weaken process-control tests; do not add new non-test code.
bead.acceptance:
1. No test in internal/harnesses/opencode/ references total_cost_usd or a top-level {"usage":...} envelope.
2. TestRunner_Execute_HappyPath asserts FinalText equals the assistant text ("PONG"), not raw JSON.
3. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
4. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
